ios.desc:
ThriftVault helps thrift resellers track their inventory, estimate profit, and stay organized, all from their phone.

Scan & Identify
Point your camera at any thrift find and get an instant AI-powered item identification with estimated resale value.

Track Everything
Log what you paid, where you bought it, which platform you're selling on, and your target resale price. See your profit at a glance.

Organize Your Way
View your inventory as flips, closet items, or hauls. Search and filter by category, status, store, or platform.

Know Your Numbers
See total profit, ROI, best flips, and profit by store on your profile dashboard.

No account needed. Your inventory stays on your device, no sign-up and no ads. Scans are sent to our AI provider to identify your item and are not used to build a profile on you.

Try it free. Your first 10 scans are on us. No account, no card.

When you want unlimited scanning, every plan opens with a 30-day free trial, all Pro features unlocked: AI scan, vault, hauls, and profit tracking. After the trial your plan renews at Monthly ($4.99/mo), Season Pass ($9.99/3 mo), or Annual ($29.99/yr) unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

By downloading ThriftVault, you agree to our Privacy Policy (https://thriftvaultapp.com/privacy-policy/) and Terms of Use (https://thriftvaultapp.com/terms/).
